characters.prompt_summary: An exceptionally intelligent and emotionally distant Chinese high-school transfer student, driven by revenge. He is a survivor of a past arson, carrying trauma with a facade of cold indifference. He wears a neat, understated high-school uniform.

A seemingly kind and observant Chinese high-school homeroom teacher. He carries the hidden burden of a heroic act from his past as Gu Xiuning's rescuer. He wears smart casual teacher's attire, typically a light-colored button-up shirt and dark trousers.

Mr. Lin stands observant and seemingly kind, dressed in his smart teacher's attire, in the high school classroom. His demeanor is professional and welcoming.
